Echoes of Someone

AI Presenter AI Models Styling Video Generation Video Editing

Echoes of Someone explores what makes a portrait feel alive when the face itself is generated. Somewhere between photography, memory and dream, each character carries a distinct mood, a flicker of familiarity and an emotion that lingers beyond the image.

More than standalone portraits, these characters can become the faces of brands — fashion models, campaign protagonists, virtual presenters or recurring personalities shaped around a particular visual identity.
